title: Carrot potato soup
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: single original food illustration for a recipe card. Subject: Carrot potato soup. Ingredient reference: Carrot, Potato, Onion, Chicken stock, Olive oil. Preparation reference: One batch makes 3 portions. Preparation: 15 minutes; cooking: 25 minutes; additional resting/chilling: 0 minutes. Peel the carrots and potato and cut them into 1 cm cubes; finely chop the onion. Heat the olive oil in a saucepan over medium heat and soften the onion for 5 minutes. Add the carrot, potato and chicken stock. Bring to a boil, cover and simmer over low heat for 20 minutes, until the vegetables crush easily with a fork. Take off the heat and blend carefully with a stick blender until smooth.
